Software Development Engineer Intern at Acme Labs

About Acme Labs
Acme Labs is hiring students to build our full stack platform. We express interest in curious people.

What you'll do:
- Build REST APIs using Node.js and Express
- Write SQL queries against PostgreSQL and design schemas
- Build UI components with React

Requirements:
• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms
• Proficiency in JavaScript or Java
• Knowledge of Git and version control
• Currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science

Nice to have:
• Familiarity with Docker
• Experience with AWS or Redis
• Understanding of operating systems and computer networks
